name: table
title: Table
description: Records people scan, compare, sort and act on: sortable columns, row selection by checkbox, a row that opens its record.

when: Records with several comparable fields on screens 640px and wider.

instead.when: The table also needs search, filters, paging or a column picker.
The screen is narrow or each record is one line of text.

builtIn: The row header column names each row for screen readers.
Sort state is announced on the column header.

genui.description: Rows of records under named columns. Keep it under 8 columns; one column is the row header.
